name: Corporate Action Option 252
definition: Provides information about the corporate action option.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

OfferType.name: Offer Type
OfferType.definition: Specifies the conditions that apply to the offer.

OptionFeatures.name: Option Features
OptionFeatures.definition: Specifies the features that may apply to a corporate action option.

OptionAvailabilityStatus.name: Option Availability Status
OptionAvailabilityStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the option.

NonDomicileCountry.name: Non Domicile Country
NonDomicileCountry.definition: Holder of the security has to certify, in line with the terms of the corporate action, that it is not domiciled in the country indicated.

ValidDomicileCountry.name: Valid Domicile Country
ValidDomicileCountry.definition: Country of domicile in which the Corporate Action option is valid. The holder of the security has to certify that it is domiciled in the country indicated.

CurrencyOption.name: Currency Option
CurrencyOption.definition: Currency in which cash proceeds are to be credited or debited.

DefaultProcessingOrStandingInstruction.name: Default Processing Or Standing Instruction
DefaultProcessingOrStandingInstruction.definition: Indicates whether the corporate action movement is a default processing or a standing instruction.

CertificationBreakdownIndicator.name: Certification Breakdown Indicator
CertificationBreakdownIndicator.definition: Indicates whether certification/breakdown is required from the account owner. |Yes: certification required |No: no certification required.

WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.name: Withdrawal Allowed Indicator
WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

ChangeAllowedIndicator.name: Change Allowed Indicator
ChangeAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether change of instruction is allowed.

AppliedOptionIndicator.name: Applied Option Indicator
AppliedOptionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the option, different from the default one, shall be applied by the account owner.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to a corporate action option.

RateAndAmountDetails.name: Rate And Amount Details
RateAndAmountDetails.definition: Provides information about rates and amounts related to a corporate action option.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a corporate action option.

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Provides information about securities quantity related to a corporate action option.

SecuritiesMovementDetails.name: Securities Movement Details
SecuritiesMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about securities movement related to a corporate action option.

CashMovementDetails.name: Cash Movement Details
CashMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the cash movement linked to the corporate action option.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information about the corporate action movement.

AdditionalTextRule.definition: If OptionType/Code is OTHR (Other), then AdditionalInformation/AdditionalText/AdditionalInformation must be present.|(MT564 NVR C5).

OptionNumberGuideline.definition: For differentiation between options, it is recommended to use the OptionNumber rather than the OptionType, for example, in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code.

RevocabilityPeriodRule.definition: If WithdrawalAllowedIndicator or ChangeAllowedIndicator is present and is 'true' or '1' (Yes), then PeriodDetails/RevocabilityPeriod must be present to indicate the period during which the change or withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

AppliedOptionRule.definition: If DefaultProcessingOrStandingInstruction/DefaultOptionIndicator is present and its value is '1' or 'true' (Yes), then AppliedOptionIndicator value must not be '1' or 'true' (Yes).

InstructCashAmountRule.definition: If OptionFeatures/Code QCAS (InstructCashAmount) is not present, then any message elements in the list (PriceDetails/MaximumCashToInstruct, PriceDetails/MinimumCashToInstruct, PriceDetails/MinimumMutipleCashToInstruct) must not be present.|(MT564 NVR C20).

DissenterRights1Rule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to DISS (DissenterRights), then OfferType/Code value equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

DissenterRights2Rule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to NDISS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable), then OfferType/Code value equal to DISS (DissenterRights) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

DissenterRights1UGRule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to DISS (DissenterRights), then OfferType/Code value equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

DissenterRights2UGRule.definition: If OfferType/Code value is equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable), then OfferType/Code value equal to DISS (DissenterRights) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)
